dedupe_keys.name: trafikverket open api for road and rail traffic information

description: Trafikverket's open API is a service for open data on road and rail traffic information in real time, which both companies and private individuals can use. Trafikverket publishes a tutorial, example code, common use cases and a data model describing the data types and their properties, and it monitors the traffic each client generates against limits set out in its documentation. Road data are also offered through DATEX II. For the rail sector, organisations with a track access (TRAV) agreement can get further dynamic rail data such as planning data, train positions, train compositions and passenger announcements through Trafikverket's data exchange portal (Datautbytesportal). Coverage is Sweden's state road and rail network. Access: free after registering as a Trafikverket customer, accepting the licence attached to the API and verifying an email address. Caveats: the data model and documentation sit in a JavaScript portal, and the richest rail data need a TRAV agreement. It supports real-time digital twins of road and rail operations, disruption and incident analysis and train delay studies, and complements the Swedish NVDB road database catalogued here.
